description: Start receiving what happens in your community as it happens: new comments with their text and ID (so you can answer them with vk_wall_create_comment), likes, new posts and reposts, people joining and leaving, messages. Turns on the community's Long Poll and the event types if they are off. VK keeps no history: only events from now on are seen, while this server runs. Read them with vk_events_get.

types.description: Event types to turn on. Default: wall_post_new, wall_repost, wall_reply_new, wall_reply_edit, wall_reply_delete, wall_reply_restore, like_add, like_remove, group_join, group_leave, message_new, message_reaction_event, poll_vote_new, photo_comment_new, video_comment_new, board_post_new, user_block, user_unblock

name: vk_events_listen

events_on.description: Event types the community now sends

long_poll_turned_on.description: Whether the community's Long Poll was off and this call turned it on

not_available.description: Requested types VK did not turn on for this community (unknown, or tied to a feature it lacks)

since.description: When listening began; nothing earlier is seen

title: Start watching the community
